g.text: Same feedback cases as b · pp = percentage points

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #302a39

g.text: Figure 2 | Distinguishing opinion change, convergence and factual improvement.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: a, Three constructed examples show round-two and round-three rating distributions for 20 hypothetical participants per example. Lines join discrete

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: proportions and are not continuous belief densities. These examples illustrate possible patterns; they were not selected from the consultations in b–c. b,

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: Each point represents one simulated consultation, compared before and after feedback or repeat rating without feedback. Points below the diagonal indicate

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: reduced disagreement. Scores are reused from the existing illustrative deliberation dataset (100 cases per arm); they were constructed directly, not

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: calculated from recorded ballots. c, The same simulated feedback cases show changes in disagreement and factual accuracy. Convergence can accompany

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: improvement or worsening; accuracy is meaningful only for questions with assessable answers. Contours in b–c enclose 50% and 90% of each estimated density

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: and are descriptive, not confidence intervals. For a real experiment, randomise consultations to feedback or no feedback, retain identical claims and

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: scales, prespecify the disagreement measure, and compare matched participants while reporting attrition. These simulations demonstrate the figure design

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: and do not establish a causal feedback effect.
